name: bikini_bottom
description: SpongeBob-style economics explainer. Mr. Krabs is capital, SpongeBob is the worker, Patrick asks the naive question, Squidward is the cynic, Sandy is the analyst.
style: SpongeBob SquarePants original 2D hand-drawn cartoon style, clean thick black outlines, flat cel shading, bright saturated palette, exactly as drawn in the television series

background.prompt: Bikini Bottom undersea meadow seen straight on. Low horizon two thirds down the frame. Upper two thirds: calm teal water fading to pale cyan, decorated only with thin pale outlines of five-petal flower shapes, small and sparse. Lower third: an open bright green grass field stretching the full width, gently rolling, small white flowers. Small purple coral bushes hug the ground at the extreme left and right edges only. Wide open empty middle with nothing in it.

krabs.look: Mr. Krabs the crab, rounded red crab body, two long light-green eye stalks with small black eyes on top, large red claws for hands, light blue short-sleeved shirt with a jagged hem, brown trousers with a black belt and gold buckle, short red legs

poses.stand: standing upright facing the viewer, both claws resting on his hips, pleased expression
poses.point: standing and pointing forward with one raised claw, explaining something, mouth open
poses.think: standing with one claw under his chin, brow furrowed, thinking hard
poses.greedy: standing with both claws clasped together, wide delighted grin, eyes gleaming
poses.worried: standing with claws raised near his face, worried anxious expression
poses.desk: sitting behind a dark wooden desk covered with papers and a ledger, leaning over the paperwork
poses.angry: standing with both claws raised in fury, mouth wide open shouting, eyes narrowed
poses.count: standing holding a stack of gold coins in one claw, counting them with a delighted greedy expression
poses.sit: sitting on a plain wooden stool, leaning forward with one claw on his knee, listening

krabs.role: the boss and the capital - wants output, hates paying for it

sponge.look: SpongeBob SquarePants, bright yellow rectangular sponge body with round holes, large blue eyes with black pupils, buck teeth, white shirt with a red necktie, brown square trousers, thin black-shoed legs

poses.stand: standing upright facing the viewer, arms at his sides, cheerful smile
poses.happy: standing with both arms raised in delight, huge open grin, eyes squeezed with joy
poses.tired: standing with slumped shoulders, drooping eyelids, exhausted expression
poses.work: standing and holding a plate in both hands, concentrating on the work
poses.confused: standing with a puzzled expression, one hand scratching the back of his head
poses.run: running to the right at full speed, arms pumping, legs a blur, determined expression
poses.think: standing with one gloved hand on his chin, eyes looking upward, thinking
poses.serve: standing holding up a round burger on a plate in both hands, proud grin
poses.sad: standing with shoulders drooping and head lowered, downturned mouth, glum

sponge.role: the worker who actually does the task

patrick.look: Patrick Star the starfish, thick pink five-pointed star body, small close-set eyes with thick eyebrows, wide mouth, green swim shorts with purple flower pattern

poses.stand: standing upright facing the viewer, arms at his sides, blank cheerful expression
poses.ask: standing with one arm raised as if asking a question, mouth open, curious look
poses.confused: standing with a completely baffled expression, mouth slightly open, eyes crossed
poses.lazy: standing with arms hanging limp, half-closed eyes, thoroughly unbothered
poses.eat: standing holding a burger up to his open mouth, about to take a bite, happy
poses.think: standing with one finger raised beside his head as if an idea arrived, eyes wide
poses.shrug: standing with both arms out to the sides and palms up, shrugging, blank expression

patrick.role: asks the naive question the audience is thinking

squid.look: Squidward Tentacles the octopus, tall pale blue-green body, large bald head, long drooping nose, heavy-lidded half-closed eyes, brown short-sleeved shirt, four tentacle legs

poses.stand: standing upright facing the viewer, arms crossed, bored unimpressed expression
poses.smug: standing with one tentacle hand raised, eyes narrowed, smug superior expression
poses.annoyed: standing with both hands on his head, exasperated irritated expression
poses.play: standing playing a black clarinet held in both tentacle hands, eyes closed, pleased with himself
poses.sigh: standing with one tentacle hand over his eyes, head tilted back, exasperated sigh

squid.role: the cynic who says the uncomfortable part out loud

sandy.look: Sandy Cheeks the squirrel, brown furry squirrel face inside a clear round glass diving helmet, white astronaut-style diving suit with a purple flower emblem on the chest, white boots and gloves

poses.stand: standing upright facing the viewer, hands on hips, confident expression
poses.explain: standing and gesturing with one open hand as if explaining a point, mouth open
poses.point: standing and pointing upward with one gloved finger, making a point, confident
poses.think: standing with arms folded and one hand on her chin, considering something

sandy.role: the analyst who explains the mechanism

props.sea_map: a nautical chart on a light cream sheet in a thin frame, pale blue landmasses and a compass rose, no readable writing

_hanging_note: Props that hang at eye level - boards, charts, maps, signage. Everything not listed stands on the ground, whatever anchor the director asks for.
_relative_height_note: Height relative to SpongeBob. The director sets one h per shot and cannot keep the cast in proportion across shots, so this multiplies it: Squidward is always taller than Patrick whatever the director asked for.
_foreground_note: Props a character stands or works behind. These are drawn last so they overlap the character's legs, which is what makes a shot read as a scene rather than as cut-outs side by side on a lawn.
_panel_color_note: Default colour for `panel` slabs: pale blue-grey, as the references use over the teal plate.
_writable_note: Props that exist to be written on - blank boards, cards, signs. Text is allowed to sit on these and is snapped to their centre. Text over anything else, especially a character, is a defect and gets moved.
